label: RX loss 0x1D2 (33 Hz)
rule: threshold 5 x 30.3 ms, strict >, checked by the 100 Hz safety task

label: RX loss 0x262 (25 Hz)
rule: threshold 5 x 40.0 ms, strict >, checked by the 100 Hz safety task

label: RX loss 0x260 (50 Hz), baseline
rule: threshold max(10 periods, 1 s), checked once per second

label: SoC heartbeat loss
rule: revoked at the 30th safety-task run; siren on the next odd 8 Hz tick

label: SoC heartbeat loss, baseline
rule: SILENT when the 1 Hz counter reaches 5

label: SoC command stall (0x2E4)
rule: 0x2E4 older than 50 ms; the revocation sounds the siren (DQ-404 A)

label: MCU hang, IWDG (nominal)
rule: 4 x (719 + 1) / 32.0 kHz, hang right after a feed

label: MCU hang, IWDG (LSI 10 % slow)
rule: 4 x (719 + 1) / 28.8 kHz, hang right after a feed

label: EPS fault -> siren
rule: refused on the first fault frame; siren after 70 task runs, next odd tick
